jobDescription: The trade settlement service matches and settles the bank's securities trades against the central depository each day. The Backend Engineer operates the service in production: deploys service changes to production through the deployment pipeline, holds a place on the settlement on-call rota and handles production incidents such as a matching backlog before the depository cut-off, watches the live settlement queue on cut-off days, coordinates depository test windows, and documents the service's boundaries. Reports to the head of settlement engineering; works with the settlement operations desk, the depository liaison and the platform team.
requirements: Has deployed settlement service changes to production through the deployment pipeline.
Holds a place on the settlement on-call rota and has handled production incidents such as a matching backlog before the depository cut-off.
Watches the live settlement queue on cut-off days and records own responsibility boundaries.
Develops and tests matching changes against the depository's test window before deployment.
Documents the service's known limitations and hand-over conditions for each change.

evidence.text: Deployed sixty-one changes to the trade settlement service in production through the deployment pipeline between 2022 and 2025, each under a change ticket in my name and a deployment record in the pipeline.

Held a place on the settlement on-call rota for the whole period and handled the production incidents that fell on my shifts, including the matching backlog of March 2024 that was cleared eleven minutes before the depository cut-off; the incident records are in the settlement incident log.
Watched the live settlement queue on cut-off days from the operations bridge, recording in the cut-off log which interventions were mine and which belonged to the operations desk.
Developed and tested each matching change against the depository's test window before deployment, with the test window results attached to the change ticket.
Documented the service's known limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change ticket's closure note and in the settlement runbook.
Work sample: the change tickets and deployment records for the last quarter, the settlement incident log record for the March 2024 backlog and the cut-off log for the same month.
Recruiter screen: the candidate described a cut-off day, the on-call shift pattern and the March 2024 backlog, with the same timings the incident record gives; the account agrees with the resume.

Hiring manager pre-read: the head of settlement engineering asks that the packet cite the deployment records and the incident log record, and keep the depository test-window work separate from the production deployments.

propositions.text: The candidate deployed sixty-one changes to the trade settlement service in production through the deployment pipeline between 2022 and 2025, each under a change ticket in his name.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the deployment records document the deployments.

propositions.text: The candidate held a place on the settlement on-call rota, handled the production incidents on his shifts including the March 2024 matching backlog, and watched the live settlement queue on cut-off days from the operations bridge.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the incident log record and the cut-off log document the on-call place, the incident and the queue watch.

propositions.text: The candidate developed and tested each matching change against the depository's test window before deployment and documented the service's known limitations and hand-over conditions in the change ticket closure notes and the runbook.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change tickets document the testing and the documentation.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the production deployments, the on-call place, the incident and the documentation.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: The production deployments, on-call place and incident handling are documented in the resume, the deployment records and the incident log; keep the environment as stated.
followUpTargets: Ask for the settlement incident log record of the March 2024 backlog to confirm the timings.
